title: FTB Max Team Size
description: Allows server owners or modpack developers to restrict the maximum team size with FTB Teams.
body:
# FTB Max Teams Size

This mod allows you to set a maximum size for FTB Teams members, allies, and more options.

I created this mod because I was surprised to see FTB Teams does not have this option by default despite being quite important.

## Configuration

The configuration file is located at config/ftb-teams-max-size.toml and will give the following options:
- `maxTeamMemberSize` = Max FTB Team member size.
- `maxTeamAlliesSize` = Max FTB Team allies size.
- `includeAllies` = Whether allies should be included in the team member size.
- `allowOPs` = Whether the mod should allow OPs to add players to teams or ally players regardless of size restrictions.
- …and more.

### More Features

If you'd like to suggest more features or any bug reports, please join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/6AEUFWWtSu).
